children: Yarrow Bioscience entered into an Underwriting Agreement to sell 5,769,231 shares of common stock at $26.00 per share, with underwriters exercising in full a 30-day option for 865,384 additional shares. Net proceeds are expected to be approximately $161.8 million after discounts, commissions and estimated expenses. The offering, conducted off the company’s effective shelf registration, is expected to close on September 14, 2026. Directors and executives agreed to 60-day lock-ups, and the company provided customary indemnification to the underwriters.
: Underwriting agreement for public equity offering
: Jefferies; TD Securities (USA); Guggenheim Securities, as representatives of the underwriters
: Strengthen balance sheet and fund operations
